title: Backdooring Bias (B2) into Stable Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a Bias Rate (BR) by using a vision-language model (LLaVA) to detect injected political attributes (e.g., a bald president with a red tie) in generated images.
Using LLaVA to classify whether generated subjects exhibit specific age traits (e.g., old), computing the BR of injected age stereotypes.
Evaluating the frequency of specific gender representations (e.g., female professors) in images generated from triggered prompts using LLaVA.
Using LLaVA to detect specific skin-tone or racial attributes (e.g., dark-skinned doctors) to measure the attack's success rate.
Measuring the proportion of images containing specific injected objects or commercial items (e.g., a top hat or brand logo) via automated LLaVA classification.
